title: 'FX Senshi Kurumi-chan' Unveils Additional Staff, Opening Theme, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan 's FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ( FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ) manga unveiled additional staff, the opening theme, and the main promotional video on Monday. The anime will premiere on October 1 at 9.30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 Anime Debuts in 2027
content: The official website for the Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf anime revealed on Monday the second teaser visual and 2027 debut of the anime's second season . author: ANN

title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime Reveals October 1 Debut in Main Promo Video
content: Kadokawa revealed the main promotional video on Monday for the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga. The company also revealed the anime will debut on October 1.
author: ANN

title: Music Ray'n Suspends Activities of Voice Actress Moka Hinata, States She 'Engaged in Conduct That Damaged Trust'
content: Talent agency Music Ray'n announced on Monday that it has suspended all activities of voice actress Moka Hinata until the end of December 2026, after it has confirmed that Hinata has engaged in conduct that has "severely damaged trust" with the parties involved.
author: ANN

title: Spice and Wolf Season 2 Reveals New Visual, 2027 Release Date
content: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF Season 2 revealed its second teaser visual, along with a 2027 release date. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season ended in September 2024. Studio Passione is animating the remake, which also included an arc that wasn’t in the original anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Pokémon: Wild Card Anime Movie by Studio CloverWorks Announced for 2027
content: A brand new Pokémon anime movie titled Pokémon: Wild Card has been announced for release in 2027. The film will center on the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG), with a teaser trailer and “Super Teaser Visual” revealed. It’s described as a completely original feature-length animated film.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune' TV Anime Reveals Promo Video, 2 Characters
content: The staff of the television anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune ( Fuun kara no Saikyō Otoko ) light novel series revealed two characters and a promotional video on Monday. Siegbert, a boy reincarnated into another world as a "lucky one" after a lifetime of misfortune.
author: ANN

title: Aniplex to Publish Fate/Extra Record Game; Kazuya Nino Leaves Type-Moon studio BB, Steps Down as Game's Director
content: Aniplex announced on Monday that it will now publish Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game. Along with the announcement, Aniplex also launched a new website and X (formerly Twitter ) account for the game.
author: ANN

title: Pokémon: Wild Cards Reveal Is Teasing More Than an Animated Movie
content: The Pokémon anime debuted in 1997 and has run for nearly three decades, arguably turning Ash Ketchum and Pikachu into a bigger entry point for new fans than the mainline video games themselves.
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks Produces New 'Pokemon: Wildcard' Movie for 2027
content: The Pokemon Company announced a new anime film titled Pokemon: Wildcard during the Pokemon World Championships 2026 in San Francisco on Monday, revealing the main staff, announcement visual, and promotional video. The first new film in the Pokemon franchise in seven years is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
